periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 60-degree inward tilt relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ellipsoid with a length-to-width ratio of approximately 1.8:1 along the primary axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Marked downward tapering toward the muzzle, extending the patch significantly below the geometric center of the eye.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Smooth U-shaped posterior boundary with no visible V-shaped vertex along the spine.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Broad transverse band occupying approximately 35% of the visible dorsal-lateral torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Separation distance approximately 1.5 times the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Continuous semi-circular curvature at the superior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-brown pigmentation across the typically white pelage of the head and dorsal regions.
